name: genesis-charter-lab

exports.createCharterLab: Create a state-dir-scoped charter workflow; stage returns hash and version (same SHA-256 value).
exports.evidenceDigest: Compute the SHA-256 digest over candidate, baseline, task, split, metric, preregistered gain, paired scores, regressions, token counts, artifactId, currentHash and measuredAt.
exports.BASELINE_CHARTERS: Public planner and worker baseline text.
exports.EVALUATOR_RULES: Frozen promotion rules; candidates cannot mutate them.

promotion: Three distinct train tasks and one separate holdout, each with preregistered measured benefit, zero regressions and a second independent verifier pass.
verifyEvidence: Required injected callback. Input receipt contains candidateHash, baselineHash, taskId, split, metric, minimumRelativeGain, artifactId, currentHash, measuredAt and computed proofDigest; return {ok:true, proofDigest, artifactId, currentHash, independentReview:true}.
state: Caller supplies stateDir; state is JSON and never reads a credential store or workspace path.
